WITH cash_cte AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    sector_cte AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    shift_cte AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_scenario_shift
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    )
SELECT ranked.investor_id,
       ranked.composite_score
FROM (
    SELECT p.investor_id,
           100.0 * (
               (
                   (c.net_cash_flow - MIN(c.net_cash_flow) OVER())
                   / NULLIF(MAX(c.net_cash_flow) OVER() - MIN(c.net_cash_flow) OVER(), 0)
               ) +
               (
                   (s.total_sector_investment - MIN(s.total_sector_investment) OVER())
                   / NULLIF(MAX(s.total_sector_investment) OVER() - MIN(s.total_sector_investment) OVER(), 0)
               ) +
               (
                   (sh.total_scenario_shift - MIN(sh.total_scenario_shift) OVER())
                   / NULLIF(MAX(sh.total_scenario_shift) OVER() - MIN(sh.total_scenario_shift) OVER(), 0)
               )
           ) / 3.0 AS composite_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
    INNER JOIN cash_cte   c  ON p.investor_id = c.investor_id
    INNER JOIN sector_cte s  ON p.investor_id = s.investor_id
    INNER JOIN shift_cte  sh ON p.investor_id = sh.investor_id
) AS ranked
ORDER BY ranked.composite_score DESC,
         ranked.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
